notes: The verse's own record contradicted itself about the head of a rule 67 frame. The peri unit's note claimed the lexical word had been taken against a prepositional-word alternative *as*, while the review note claimed both frames were headed on the prepositional word. *as touching* carries no lexical noun, so rule 67's divided head does not reach it and *touching* is the word that realizes peri; *in the place concerning* does carry a supplied noun and is the divided case. Notes and review notes only: every source and target edge and every head is identical to the accepted alignment.
